newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN IPO - Vaibhav Gems Ltd.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN IPO - Vaibhav Gems Ltd.

text.p: Research supplied by Sebastian Dominic of Resource Base, a New Delhi-based private investment consultancy firm. Tel: 578 0840. This data is for investor information only and does not constitute a recommendation by Reuters.
No of Shares Premium of Aggregate
Face value Rs 10 Rs 20 per value

Vaibhav Gems Limited is coming out with this public issue to set up a manufacturing unit for studded gold jewellery, to augment long term working capital requirements and to meet the expenses of the issue.

The cost of the project estimated at 138 million rupees is proposed to be financed through 29.30 million rupees share capital, 58.70 million rupees share premium, 25 million rupees by term loans and 25 million rupees by internal accruals.

Major components of the project cost include 10 million rupees for land and building, 27.70 million rupees for plant and machinery, 6 million rupees for technical know-how and training, 7.50 million rupees for public issue expenses, 6 million rupees for contingencies and 66.50 million rupees for working capital requirements.

Vaibhav Gems is in the business of cutting and polishing rough gemstones and exporting it. The company also procures finished gemstones from the local market for export. The stones are exported to Japan, Hong Kong, Thailand and Taiwan.
The new jewellery unit with an installed capacity of 750 kg of gold per annum is a forword integration exercise for the company.

Stones produced from the existing facilities of the company will be used in the manufacture of studded jewellery. The firm has a technical tie-up with Pippo Perez of Italy for the supply of designs, technical know how and the use of the brand name.
